# Built by Josh Studio

> Creative & technical studio in Kansas — built from the ground up by one person (Josh): Tynkr Tools & Co Notion OS templates, Excel + Google Sheets workbooks, The Guided Series print planners, Tynkr local-first Windows desktop apps, zodiac digital art print bundles, J.S. Warden fiction, the Nước Mắm cookbook, Josh & Jordan's Kitchen videos, and free browser utilities.

## About & Authority

- **Legal entity**: Built by Josh Studio LLC, a Kansas limited liability company (Kansas Business ID 10076138), formed in 2026; studio began in 2025.
- **Founder**: Josh — solo developer, author, designer, and support contact across all studio lines. `support@builtbyjoshstudio.com` is answered directly by the founder.
- **Studio network (five canonical sites)**:
  - Root commerce, templates, planners, zodiac art & blog: https://builtbyjoshstudio.com/
  - Desktop apps (Tynkr Tools & Co): https://tynkr.builtbyjoshstudio.com/ (index: https://tynkr.builtbyjoshstudio.com/llms.txt)
  - Cooking, recipes, cookbook & kitchen tools: https://cooking.builtbyjoshstudio.com/ (index: https://cooking.builtbyjoshstudio.com/llms.txt)
  - Money & business browser tools: https://tools.builtbyjoshstudio.com/money/ (index: https://tools.builtbyjoshstudio.com/llms.txt)
  - Fiction by J.S. Warden & tabletop RPG tools: https://writing.builtbyjoshstudio.com/ (index: https://writing.builtbyjoshstudio.com/llms.txt)
- **Full studio index**: https://builtbyjoshstudio.com/llms-full.txt (includes complete product fact sheets and visible FAQs).

## Desktop Apps — Tynkr Tools & Co

Privacy-first, local-first Windows desktop software (data stays in local files on your machine — no cloud, no accounts, no subscriptions; pay-once model through the Microsoft Store). Full documentation and suite comparison: https://tynkr.builtbyjoshstudio.com/

- [Tynkr Ledger — Personal Finance OS](https://tynkr.builtbyjoshstudio.com/ledger/): Local-first budgeting, transaction ledger, bills, debt payoff, and net worth tracking.
- [Tynkr Vault — Second Brain OS](https://tynkr.builtbyjoshstudio.com/vault/): Local-first Markdown notes, tasks, tags, and fast fuzzy search on your own disk.
- [Tynkr Hearth — Homebuyer OS](https://tynkr.builtbyjoshstudio.com/hearth/): Local-first mortgage comparison, down payment tracking, cash-to-close math, roadmap, and document checklist.
- [Tynkr Forge — Small Business OS](https://tynkr.builtbyjoshstudio.com/forge/): Local-first invoicing, CRM, purchase orders, contracts, expenses, and proposals in one workspace.
- [Tynkr Inkpress — Book Formatting](https://tynkr.builtbyjoshstudio.com/inkpress/): Turn a manuscript into an EPUB 3 ebook, KDP print PDF, and author-site web page on Windows — no cloud, no accounts, no subscriptions.

## Writing, Cooking & Free Web Tools (Sister Subdomains)

- **Writing & Tabletop (`writing.builtbyjoshstudio.com`)**:
  - [Writing Hub](https://writing.builtbyjoshstudio.com/) & [Books Hub](https://writing.builtbyjoshstudio.com/books/): *Overlayed Echoes* (near-future LitRPG novel by J.S. Warden — Kindle $5.99 / KU, paperback $12.99, hardcover $23.99), *Ebonspire Chronicles* (dark fantasy detective noir by J.S. Warden — Kindle $7.99 / KU, paperback $14.99, hardcover $25.99), plus interactive companion fiction.
  - [Tabletop & RPG Web Tools](https://writing.builtbyjoshstudio.com/tabletop/): Free, ad-free, local-first game-night utilities (initiative tracker, dice roller, session notes, random tables, character/NPC/tavern/plot hook/loot generators, wargame score tracker).
- **Cooking (`cooking.builtbyjoshstudio.com`)**:
  - [Cooking Hub](https://cooking.builtbyjoshstudio.com/) & [Kitchen Videos](https://cooking.builtbyjoshstudio.com/videos/): *Nước Mắm: Simple Vietnamese Home Cooking* cookbook by Josh Tran ($3.49 direct digital / $7.99 paperback) and Josh & Jordan's Kitchen on YouTube — no-talking videos filmed as tight method cuts and minimally cut full-process sessions at normal speed (Josh covers savory home cooking and Vietnamese staples; Jordan covers baking, breads, and pastries).
  - [Kitchen & Cooking Web Tools](https://cooking.builtbyjoshstudio.com/tools/): Free, ad-free, local-first kitchen calculators (scaling, dough hydration, brine ratios, thawing, pan swap, nutrition, roast timing, cost per serving).
- **Money & Business (`tools.builtbyjoshstudio.com`)**:
  - [Money & Business Web Tools](https://tools.builtbyjoshstudio.com/money/): Free, ad-free, local-first personal finance and small-business calculators (50/30/20 budget, debt payoff, compound interest, emergency fund, freelance rate, home affordability, invoice generator, loan payment, profit margin, quarterly tax, savings goal, take-home pay).

## Beyond the Studio & Commerce Facts

- **Checkout**: Lemon Squeezy (`builtbyjoshstudio.lemonsqueezy.com`) is the primary checkout for templates, workbooks, the cookbook, and digital zodiac art bundles with instant delivery and no account required. Etsy (`tynkrtoolsandco.etsy.com` and `etsy.com/shop/BuiltByJoshStudio`) is a secondary storefront; Amazon carries print paperbacks and books; Redbubble (`redbubble.com/people/BBJStudio/shop`) carries celestial zodiac designs on finished goods; Microsoft Store handles Tynkr desktop app purchases.
- **Policies**: [Refund Policy](https://builtbyjoshstudio.com/refunds.html) (digital sales final with legally required exceptions; technical issues fixed; Microsoft handles desktop app refunds) · [Privacy Policy](https://builtbyjoshstudio.com/privacy.html) · [Terms of Service](https://builtbyjoshstudio.com/terms.html)
- **Other studio properties**: [Little Acre Learning](https://littleacrelearning.com/) (children's books & printables — separate brand of Built by Josh Studio LLC) · [Substack Newsletter](https://tynkrtoolsco.substack.com/) · [YouTube — Josh & Jordan's Kitchen](https://www.youtube.com/@joshandjordanskitchen) · [YouTube — Tales of Ink & Shadows Studio](https://www.youtube.com/@TalesofInkShadowsStudio) · [Linktree](https://linktr.ee/builtbyjoshstudio)
